secrets.name: The Room in the Catalogue
secrets.text: The drawer went back twenty metres further than the cabinet is deep. At the end of it somebody has set up a desk and a bed, and has been writing out cards of their own.

meta.label: The Card Catalogue
meta.blurb: Somewhere in these drawers is a card for every book in the library, including yours. The drawers are the size of cars. One of them has been left open.
